_comment: Hand-authored mock ad references. These are NOT produced by generate_ad_creatives.py — no creative generation runs in this pipeline. They exist so mock visitors arrive with realistic UTMs and so an identified lead can be traced back to the angle that brought them in, which the outreach email then references. Angles mirror the three ad_creator templates: A = concrete metrics landing on 'one place', B = fictional company + believable stat, C = provocative one-liner.
